name: v9.19.0
body:
User-facing changes:
* Detection can now be forced to read the filesystem instead of git history. Practical effect: if a repo has uncommitted license changes, users can choose current working tree contents rather than the committed git view.
* Unsupported non-GitHub remote URLs now raise a clear error instead of being treated as something Licensee might know how to scan.
* Package metadata matching now consumes SPDX suffixes like -or-later and -only. Practical effect: package files that say things like LGPL-3.0-or-later can now resolve to the correct base license instead of falling through to other.
* HTML comments are now stripped during normalization before similarity/matching. Practical effect: licenses embedded in HTML or commented fragments are less likely to mismatch because of markup noise.
* Repositories with a top-level LICENSES directory now scanned. Practical effect: projects that store SPDX-named license texts under LICENSES are more likely to be detected correctly.

name: Rugged
body:
- Matching algorithm completely rewritten, special thanks to @vmg 
- Now uses [Rabin-Karp rolling-hashes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rabin%E2%80%93Karp_algorithm), Git's native comparison mechanism
- Performance so fast [we can't even measure it](https://gist.github.com/benbalter/b1c79a9435c0ed6d1388)
- All potential matches now calculated before determining the one with highest similiarity
- Use Git for diffs
- "No license" now excluded from potential matches
